steps.title: Withdraw your MKR and WETH from the pool

steps.signature: mkrToSky(address,uint256)

warnings.text: This MKR sits in a Uniswap v2 liquidity position you hold. Withdrawing returns your share of MKR and WETH; the MKR is then migrated. If you're providing liquidity on purpose, you can ignore this.
A delayed-upgrade fee applies and rises over time (about 5% now, stepping up roughly every 3 months). The simulated amount is what you'd get today.

holding.label: in a Uniswap v2 MKR/WETH position

verification.notes: Uniswap v2 pair 0xC2aDdA861F89bBB333c90c492cB837741916A225 (MKR/WETH), 424 MKR pooled at listing. The amount replicates UniswapV2Pair.burn: _mintFee (feeTo is set on this factory) mints totalSupply*(sqrt(k)-sqrt(kLast))/(5*sqrt(k)+sqrt(kLast)) first, then pays liquidity*balance/totalSupply. Withdraw via Router02.removeLiquidity with 1% minimums.
